testBuildNote: The frozen v48 working-tree artifact was tested before its publication commit. All published runtime bytes must match; only release.json sourceCommit changes after commit.
nativeSessionNote: Passing Safari reports span two retained visible sessions; Firefox reports span two retained headless sessions with real WebGL and trusted WebDriver input. Safari repeated the full older dining case after arrival beat the tester to its Stop control. Firefox repeated the full older atelier case after a native navigation timeout. Earlier incomplete preflight/startup attempts are excluded. Every required case has a passing report checked against one frozen artifact/test fingerprint per browser; these runs establish functional coverage across resumed sessions, not long-session GPU stress or physical-device performance.

safari.verification: Native Developer settings checkbox visibly read Value: 0 after the passing suite; settings window closed.

compactLayoutReviewNote: Compiled Chromium viewport checks at 320, 390 and 768 pixels cover selected ceramic facts, source formats, free study save and direct shop exit. No page overflow; inspected targets are at least 44 pixels. Native matrices repeat compact layout and keyboard checks. Physical phones/tablets and touch hardware were not tested.
